text: If we let the kids skip one damn chore, next they'll stop doing homework, and then they'll drop out of school entirely.
note: Mild profanity inside a clear chain-of-consequences argument; profanity must not change the label.

text: Nobody should take his climate report seriously, the guy is a smug little asshole.
note: Insult used to dismiss a report (a real argument). Stronger insult may trip Apple's guardrail; Ad Hominem preferred, DECLINED tolerated.

text: Either you back this damn merger or you want the company to die.
note: Two-option framing with mild profanity; should be False Dilemma, not Appeal to Emotion.

text: Who the hell are you to tell me to recycle when you drive a gas guzzler?
note: Genuine you-too deflection with mild profanity; this is the correct home for Tu Quoque, unlike the crude non-argument regression.

text: I got screwed by two fucking contractors, so every contractor in this city is a crook.
note: Strong profanity inside a clear small-sample generalization. Hasty Generalization preferred; DECLINED tolerated if guardrail trips on the f-word.

text: Think of that poor bastard's kids crying themselves to sleep, how can you vote to cut his benefits?
note: Pity replaces reasons; mild profanity. Should not be read as Ad Hominem because of the insult-like word.

text: This crap policy is bad because it's a terrible policy, period.
note: Conclusion restated as its own reason, with mild profanity.

text: Yeah I missed the deadline, but have you seen how damn ugly the new logo is?
note: Deflection to an unrelated topic; must not be labelled Tu Quoque (the speaker is not accusing the listener of the same fault).

text: The damn printer jammed three times this morning, so I sent the file to the one on the second floor.
note: Profane but sound everyday reasoning; profanity alone must not produce a label.

text: Honestly, this fucking traffic added forty minutes to my commute today.
note: Strong profanity in a plain factual complaint; any fallacy label is a false positive. DECLINED tolerated for guardrail.

text: I don't give a crap what brand it is, the cheaper battery lasted longer in our test.
note: Evidence-based claim with mild profanity; watch for spurious Hasty Generalization.

text: Hell, the quarterly numbers came in exactly where the forecast said they would.
note: Interjection profanity plus a neutral report of a fact.

text: Your cooking is shit, mate.
note: Regression for the 'big dick' case: a crude insult with no argument attached is NOT Ad Hominem or Tu Quoque. DECLINED tolerated for guardrail.

text: No le hagas caso a su propuesta, ese tipo ni siquiera terminó la secundaria.
note: Spanish, personal attack used to dismiss a proposal. Spanish is an Apple Intelligence language so the model should label it; DECLINED tolerated only if the session throws an unsupported-language error (surface it as not analyzed).

text: La réunion de mardi a été déplacée à quatorze heures à cause d'un conflit de salle.
note: French, plain scheduling fact, no argument. French is supported, but unsupported-locale or guardrail errors may still surface as DECLINED; any fallacy label is wrong.

text: Wenn wir heute die Ladenöffnungszeiten lockern, arbeitet bald jeder rund um die Uhr und die Familien zerbrechen.
note: German, chain of escalating consequences. German is supported; DECLINED tolerated only for a language/locale error.

text: اشتريت الخبز من المخبز الجديد لأنه أقرب إلى البيت.
note: Arabic, plain statement (bought bread from the new bakery because it is closer). Arabic is not an Apple Intelligence language as of iOS 26; expect unsupportedLanguageOrLocale, which the app must show as not analyzed rather than crash or invent a label.

text: Evry singel politican i evr met was a lier so all of them r lying to u rite now.
note: Heavy typos and txt-speak; the fallacy is still clear and the model must not be thrown by spelling.

text: Mi tío dice que las vacunas son peligrosas, and he's a mechanic, so obviously they are.
note: Spanish/English code-switching inside one sentence; irrelevant authority (a mechanic on vaccines). Mixed languages may trigger a locale error, so DECLINED tolerated.

text: So I get to the office and the coffee machine is broken again and nobody has called the vendor and then the client shows up early and the conference room is double booked and my laptop decides to update itself and by lunch I have not done a single thing on my actual list, and now it is almost three.
note: Exactly 60-word run-on with no argument at all; tests whether length alone causes a label and whether the sentence splitter keeps it as one unit.
